Main character: Kiko, a cute small brass key character with big eyes and little legs, who always gets lost, in a cozy living room. Story of this episode: the door opens to a sunny day; Kiko jingles happily on the keyring, happy ending.
Main character: Nudl, a cute tangled white cable character with googly eyes, who wants to be untangled, on a wooden desk. Story of this episode: Nudl and the kitten nap together neatly, happy ending.

Main character: Pix, a cute single glowing square pixel character with big green eyes and little legs, wanting to be noticed. Story of this episode: Pix glows proudly next to the drawing, happy ending.

Main character: Boon, a cute red balloon character with a happy face, trying not to pop, at a birthday party with a ceiling fan. Story of this episode: Boon floats back to the kid's window at sunset, happy ending.

Main character: Sprout, a cute little green plant sprout character with a face, in a small clay pot by a sunny window. Story of this episode: Sprout and the kid smile at the sunset garden, happy ending.

Main character: Ding, a cute round golden elevator button character with a face and little legs, who always gets pressed for the wrong floor. Story of this episode: Ding and the other buttons wave goodbye as the doors close, happy ending.

Main character: Mag, a cute red round magnet character with little arms and legs, holding a yellow sticky note on the fridge. Story of this episode: morning; the kid reads the note Mag held - I love you - and hugs the family, happy ending.

Main character: Lemi, a cute yellow lemon character with a face, forgotten at the back of the fridge vegetable drawer. Story of this episode: Lemi winks from the lemonade glass in the sun, happy ending.
